text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

You are a man, the successful candidate is a man, and the panel was all men. An all-male panel is a legitimate concern about process and diversity in general, but it gives you no grievance here — if anything it points away from your sex being a disadvantage. Raising it would weaken your credibility on the points that actually matter.

Those points are stronger: you hold a master's and a professional licence against a bachelor's degree, plus twelve years in municipal planning, and the stated rationale rests on one vaguely described strength. Press instead on the unanswered request — chase the written reasons, note the two-week silence, and ask what criteria and weightings were used.
